C-PLANS-CALENDAR-DATE-261.Summary: Make the plans browser regression navigate to its fixed August 2026 fixture instead of depending on the runner's current month.
C-PLANS-CALENDAR-DATE-261.Problem: `tests/browser/plans.spec.mjs` creates a calendar item on 15 August 2026 but immediately expects the calendar title to contain August. The application correctly opens on the actual current month, so the test began failing on 1 September 2026 and now blocks unrelated pull requests.

Goals.Goal: Navigate from the actual displayed calendar month to August 2026 through the existing previous/next controls before asserting the fixture.
Keep the test deterministic across calendar months, years and runner time zones.
Restore the normal plans browser gate without modifying production behavior.

Constraints.Constraint: The exact base is main e6c767949a19a9232e19d95fd8f0632d978f9e69.
Only the browser test and this GRACE bundle may change.
No production UI, API, SQLite, date logic, system clock, dependency, workflow or mobile scenario is changed.
The test must use the same visible period controls available to a user.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Freeze or mock the application clock.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The test computes a signed month distance from the current browser date to August 2026 and clicks the correct visible period control exactly that many times.
The calendar title is checked for August 2026 before the created event is asserted.
The focused desktop plans test passes when run in September 2026 and remains valid before or after August 2026.
npm check, unit tests, the full plans browser command and GRACE final pass on one exact head before merge.
After squash merge, post-merge CI succeeds and the change is moved to terminal archive separately.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: The same fixed August fixture is reached through real calendar controls without any production or mobile-mode change.
